column6: fix "to"-placement: it was outside the bracket ("I am going to [do something]"), which duplicates "to" when a lesson splits "voy a" and the infinitive into separate blocks ("voy a"+"comprar" -> "I am going to"+"to buy"). Move inside the bracket to match querer/poder's established convention ("to want [to do something]").
